model.spatialLattice: square N by N periodic lattice
model.probe: O_a=2 sum_k K_a |z_k|^2, normalized so each particle occupation carries Q_a=K_a/E_k
model.scope: gradient part of the integrated metric-strain vertex; not the complete renormalized stress tensor

response.positiveFrequencyCone: for omega>0 every exact spectral atom is a nonnegative multiple of K K^T and is positive semidefinite
analyticProperties: chiR is analytic in the upper half-plane
positive-frequency spectral atoms are positive semidefinite
chiR(z) falls as z^-2 because the positive and negative poles cancel at order z^-1

continuationBoundary.zeroFrequencyFact: the occupation-number part commutes with the free Hamiltonian and has no nonzero-frequency retarded commutator
continuationBoundary.pairPart: the same metric vertex also contains particle-antiparticle pair terms at omega=2E; these, not Cocc alone, produce the retarded spectral response
continuationBoundary.verdict: the third direction is not the analytic continuation of the 1228 static occupation covariance, but an orientation-odd third direction can independently survive in the pair spectral measure

decomposition.orientationOdd: R_orient_odd=(R_x-P R_x P)/2 with P exchanging x and y
decomposition.thirdDirection: orientationOdd is proportional to diag(1,-1), normal to the exchange-symmetric H2 plane
